video_goal: Demonstrate how to endorse a paper check and deposit it using the Chase Mobile app's camera capture feature.
required_subjects_and_props: Smartphone with Chase Mobile app installed, physical paper check, blue or black ink pen, dark flat surface.

outline_steps.visual_action: A hand taps the blue Chase Mobile app icon on a smartphone home screen.
The Chase app dashboard loads, and a finger taps the 'Pay & Transfer' tab at the bottom, then selects 'Deposit checks'.
A hand places a physical paper check face-down on a dark, flat surface.
A blue ink pen writes a signature on the endorsement line on the back of the check.
A finger taps the 'Amount' field in the Chase app and types in the check's numerical value using the on-screen keypad.
The finger taps the 'Front' camera icon button on the deposit screen.
The smartphone is held over the front of the check, aligning the paper within the green rectangular guide on the screen.
The Chase app camera interface flashes white as it auto-captures the front of the check, displaying a cropped preview.
The hand flips the physical check over to reveal the newly signed back.
The finger taps the 'Back' camera icon button on the app interface.
The smartphone is held over the back of the check, aligning the signature within the on-screen green rectangular guide.
The camera auto-captures the back of the check, showing the cropped preview image next to the front image.
A finger scrolls down the review screen and taps the solid blue 'Deposit' button at the bottom.
A green checkmark appears on the screen with the text 'Deposit received'.
